name: Whisparr Sync
summary: Keeps Cove in step with the Whisparr instance you configure, calling out to it with an API key you supply and Cove holds server-side. Connect to either Whisparr generation, test the connection, and register Cove's import callback so what Whisparr imports reaches your library. Monitor and unmonitor a studio or a performer from its own Cove page, or a whole selection at once. From that same menu, register the scenes Cove holds that Whisparr does not and ask Whisparr to link files you already own into place; neither downloads anything. One separately named action, Search all monitored, asks Whisparr to search and download - it acts on one entity at a time and is not offered for a selection. A Missing tab on studio, performer and tag pages lists the scenes your metadata source knows about and your library does not hold, and marks one scene or a page of scenes wanted without downloading anything; its own Search action asks Whisparr for a single scene and does download. Filling that tab calls outward to the metadata source Cove is configured with, using the key Cove already holds for it, and your browser fetches each cover image straight from that source. One endpoint answers anonymously - the import callback Whisparr posts to - and it is authenticated by a secret this extension mints rather than by a Cove permission; every other endpoint requires one.
